description: This is a Java source file for a Spring Boot REST controller handling banking account operations, including fetching accounts, account details, creating accounts, transferring funds, and retrieving transactions.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST controller for account and transaction operations, managing endpoints for CRUD operations and transfers related to bank accounts.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all bank accounts.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves details of an account by its account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account associated with a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a fund transfer based on provided transfer details for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches transaction history for a specific account.
